subtitle: Out Cebu · Philippine Airlines
overview: A winter Tokyo tour with a snow day: Shibuya Crossing, Oishi Park and Lake Kawaguchi, and up to two hours at the Yeti ski resort (ski rental not included). Visit Asakusa Temple and Tokyo Skytree, with free time in Shinjuku and a free day for an optional Disneyland trip. Fly Cebu – Narita and back with Philippine Airlines; stay in 4-star hotels.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Jan 18–22 2027 to Feb 8–12 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Shibuya Crossing: Tokyo's famous scramble crossing, one of the busiest pedestrian crossings in the world.
placeDesc.Hachiko Statue: A bronze statue of the loyal dog Hachiko, a popular meeting spot outside Shibuya Station.
placeDesc.Oishi Park: A lakeside park on Lake Kawaguchi with flower gardens and views of Mt. Fuji.
placeDesc.Lake Kawaguchi: One of the Fuji Five Lakes, known for views of Mt. Fuji.
placeDesc.Yeti Ski Resort: A ski resort on the slopes of Mt. Fuji; up to 2 hours, ski rental not included.
placeDesc.Asakusa Temple: Senso-ji, Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, entered through the Kaminarimon gate.
placeDesc.Nakamise Shopping Street: A traditional shopping street of souvenir and snack stalls leading to Asakusa Temple.
placeDesc.Tokyo Skytree: Tokyo's tallest tower, with a photo stop on this tour.
placeDesc.Shinjuku: A major Tokyo shopping and entertainment district, with free time for shopping.
placeDesc.Disneyland: An optional full-day visit on the free day, with ticket and round-trip transfer.
